name: Postgres Pool Exhaustion in Worker
description: Production database connection pool exhaustion with traceback and internal server IP.
email_subject: CRITICAL: Connection pool exhausted on node 10.240.0.14
email_body:
Hi Support Team,
Our backend processing pipeline halted at 04:12 UTC. We are seeing connection pool exhaustion on database worker 10.240.0.14.

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/workers/ingest.py", line 142, in process_batch
    conn = db_pool.get_connection(timeout=30)
  File "/app/db/pool.py", line 58, in get_connection
psycopg2.OperationalError: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections

Please check if our concurrency limits were throttled.
Contact our on-call engineer at markus.schmidt@fintech-cloud.de or +49 89 2018 4099.

Regards,
Markus Schmidt
Principal SRE

X-Delivery-Attempt: 844
X-Triage-Signature: sha256=a1b2c3d4e5f6

Could you adjust the retry backoff schedule for account ID acc_98821?

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Lead Integration Architect

name: Rate Limiting Reset Header Desynchronization
description: X-RateLimit-Reset time is in the past.
email_subject: Header X-RateLimit-Reset returns Unix timestamp in the past
email_body:
Hi Engineering,
When we hit the rate limit on /v1/orders, the response header 'X-RateLimit-Reset' sends timestamp 1700000000 which is in the past. This causes our backoff library to enter a zero-wait loop.

Please ensure the timestamp uses current UTC epoch seconds.

Rachel Green
Senior Software Engineer

Bill Anderson
